sections.title: Communication
sections.subtitle: Questions about how your child communicates

questions.text: Does your child respond when their name is called?
Does your child use words or sentences to communicate needs?
Does your child point to objects they want or find interesting?
Does your child repeat words or phrases out of context (echolalia)?
How well does your child understand verbal instructions?

sections.title: Social Interaction
sections.subtitle: Questions about your child's relationships and social behaviour

questions.text: Does your child enjoy playing with other children?
Does your child make eye contact during interactions?
Does your child show affection to familiar people?
Does your child prefer to play alone rather than with others?
How would you rate your child's overall social skills?

sections.title: Behaviour
sections.subtitle: Questions about your child's behaviour and daily routines

questions.text: Does your child have repetitive body movements (rocking, hand-flapping)?
Does your child insist on specific routines and become upset when they change?
Does your child show self-injurious behaviour (head banging, biting self)?
Does your child show aggression toward others?
Describe any specific behaviour challenges you observe at home.

sections.title: Sensory
sections.subtitle: Questions about how your child responds to sensory input

questions.text: Does your child show unusual sensitivity to sounds (covering ears, distress)?
Does your child avoid or seek out touch?
Does your child appear to have a high or low pain threshold?
Can your child dress and undress independently?
Can your child manage personal hygiene independently?
How many hours does your child sleep per night on average?
Describe your child's eating habits and any food-related concerns.
What do you feel are your child's greatest strengths?
